summary.text: On Ravnica, ten guilds have kept the peace for ten thousand years under the Guildpact, but on the eve of its anniversary a sinister force threatens it.
At the Decamillennial the Boros agent Agrus Kos arrests Szadek, the head of House Dimir, and unwittingly breaks the Guildpact, which throws Ravnica into chaos.

Meanwhile construction in the Utvara district awakens five nephilim, who feed on a dragon corpse and grow in power, and the last of them die in the center of Ravnica City after Niv-Mizzet kills two and Rakdos kills another.
